policy.least_work_scope: work_delegation_gate direct-execution routing applies only to the separate gate-owned task queue; authoritative O revision 24 forbids applying revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
policy.candidate_identity: Canonical source-qualified identity is mandatory. Never join by bare short candidate id, display label, prefix/suffix heuristic or semantic/fuzzy alias.
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separate fields even when produced by one comparator run
policy.control_freshness: Every non-exploration invocation must resolve a fresh note main SHA after that invocation starts using a SHA-only Git ref lookup; never reuse a prior invocation's cached head. Fetch DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE at that exact SHA, then perform a second SHA-only head lookup immediately before the first substantive semantic read. If head or relevant control/config changed, refetch and restart the presemantic bootstrap. Record bootstrap_head_observed_at >= invocation_started_at, the frozen main SHA, root control revision/blob, downstream control revision/blob and role config revision. After semantic work begins, freeze the tuple for the invocation. If semantic data was read before this guard completed, mark bootstrap_valid=false, do not publish a result eligible for downstream integration, persist a diagnostic receipt, and retry next invocation. Do not use generic commit/search/branch payloads merely to resolve head freshness.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Audits and comparators must carry bootstrap_valid=true plus the frozen control tuple in both their durable receipt and any downstream-consumable output. Integrator must reject/defer any triplet or audit correction with bootstrap_valid missing/false or an explicitly recorded presemantic bootstrap-order defect. Historical artifacts remain provenance evidence but are not reinterpreted under newer control.
policy.bridge_freshness: bridge pins feed to observed note main SHA, rechecks head via SHA-only ref lookup before mutation, refetches on head advance/revision regression, and never regresses tracked feed revision

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: Before new admission while O clean cursor lags, compare candidate against all unacknowledged feed items by source-qualified identity, mechanism, decision question, tested scope and uncertainty. Admit only material incremental decision information. Supersede/replace better/newer representations of same item while retaining provenance/supersession chain. Semantically deduplicate equivalent items; never drop distinct decision-relevant items for arbitrary count cap.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit all metrics on every integrator run, even when no admission occurs, so backlog policy observability is continuous

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: If no incomplete active wave exists, seal one source-qualified artifact/blob per clean namespace from latest valid role-local pointer/checkpoint; keep incomplete wave immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: novelty/relevance and evidence comparators evaluate exact ACTIVE_WAVE and carry wave_id, manifest blob and source_set_digest; no moving-latest substitution.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: Integrator requires a bootstrap-valid exact-wave final novelty/relevance pair with identical full canonical candidate manifest/count/digest. Evidence may be a bootstrap-valid mechanically validated subset of that full pair; join only canonical_candidate_key, mark omitted candidates evidence_status=not_assessed, reject ambiguous/nonmember evidence rows, preserve evidence coverage metrics, then reconcile/readback/mark integrated and seal the next wave.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

policy.capacity_invariant: Logical disable is fail-closed behavior, not optimization. Repository enablement and platform execution are distinct. A repository-enabled bounded-support role that is physically inactive does not consume an active slot and may not be described as executing. When all intended physical managed slots are already occupied, bounded gate-owned mechanical maintenance may be executed by the existing automation_optimizer fallback contract instead of changing the platform scheduler. Fallback must preserve the gate's task ownership, idempotency, one-task bound and write isolation, and must stop immediately if the physical gate becomes active.

candidate_identity_contract.source_local_candidate_id: Exact candidate identifier as declared in the sealed source artifact; do not decorate or rewrite it for joins. A human-readable qualified/display label is a separate non-key field.
candidate_identity_contract.canonical_candidate_key: sha256 of UTF-8 bytes of JSON array [namespace, source_artifact_blob, source_local_candidate_id] serialized with compact separators(',',':') and ensure_ascii=false; exactly these displayed tuple values are hashed
candidate_identity_contract.full_pair_manifest: Final novelty and decision-relevance outputs must carry the identical ordered manifest of [namespace, source_artifact_blob, source_local_candidate_id, canonical_candidate_key] and the same assessment_count/candidate_set_digest over that canonical manifest.
candidate_identity_contract.evidence_subset: Evidence may cover a source-qualified subset of the full pair. Every evidence row must carry source_local_candidate_id and canonical_candidate_key; integration eligibility requires mechanical membership in the full pair manifest. Display labels or legacy rewritten candidate_id strings are never sufficient for a join.
candidate_identity_contract.legacy_repair: A bootstrap-valid producer may publish an immutable identity-normalization reissue/supplement for an unchanged exact wave without changing prior semantic judgments. Rebuild all current-wave tuples from the exact sealed source artifacts, recompute every key under schema 2, validate 100% equality, then recompute the candidate-set digest; preserve predecessor/supersession provenance and read back before receipt/pointer publication.
candidate_identity_contract.recompute_boundary: Construct the final current-wave tuple first, then recompute canonical_candidate_key from that tuple. Never copy, cache, inherit or reuse a key from a predecessor wave, predecessor source blob, prior manifest or semantic-judgment cache, even when the semantic judgment itself is reused.
candidate_identity_contract.publication_self_audit: Before any final novelty/relevance artifact, pointer or receipt becomes downstream-consumable, mechanically recompute every canonical_candidate_key from the displayed full-pair tuple and require 100% exact equality. Only after that validation compute candidate_set_digest from the validated ordered canonical manifest. On any mismatch publish a diagnostic/provenance-only artifact, do not advance final pointers, and do not advertise the pair as integration-eligible.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Before any clean artifact or public-source semantic read, complete the invocation-local presemantic freshness guard and emit bootstrap_valid=true only after two current-run SHA-only head checks bracket root/downstream config resolution. If the guard is violated, publish only a diagnostic receipt and no audit eligible for downstream use. Otherwise verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; prefer active sealed wave/admitted feed where useful; after urgent feed candidates rotate across under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted; carry the frozen control tuple in audit outputs.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Before any clean artifact, audit, repository or public-source semantic read, complete the invocation-local presemantic freshness guard; on any ordering violation publish only a diagnostic receipt, never a downstream-eligible audit. Otherwise audit implementation and reproduction evidence for high-value clean candidates, prioritizing exact ACTIVE_WAVE and admitted feed where useful. Inspect official repositories/releases/configs/checkpoints/benchmark harnesses and independent reproductions or failed replications. Distinguish published claim, official artifact support, independent numerical reproduction, failed reproduction, missing dependencies/config, and O-specific adaptation. Preserve source-qualified identity and exact tested scope; never steer exploration or write worker feedback. Carry bootstrap_valid=true and the frozen control tuple in outputs.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Resolve a new current-run SHA-only head after invocation start, fetch root/downstream at that exact SHA, and recheck immediately before reading ACTIVE_WAVE or O. If the presemantic guard is invalid, emit only a diagnostic receipt. Otherwise evaluate the exact sealed wave and publish novelty/status plus decision relevance as one complete final pair. Use candidate_identity_contract schema 2. Preserve exact source_local_candidate_id from each sealed source artifact and first assemble each current-wave tuple [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id]. Recompute canonical_candidate_key from the displayed current tuple using UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=false; semantic-judgment reuse may reuse only the judgment, never a prior canonical key, manifest row or digest. Key inheritance/caching across waves or source-blob changes is forbidden. Both outputs must carry the identical ordered full canonical manifest, assessment_count and candidate_set_digest. Immediately before final publication, mechanically recompute every key from the displayed manifest and require 100% equality; compute candidate_set_digest only after that audit. If any row fails, publish diagnostic/provenance-only output and do not advance final pointers or claim integration eligibility. Provisional/partial results must not use downstream-consumable paths. Publish only immutable/versioned bootstrap_valid=true publication_state=final artifacts with exact wave_id/manifest blob/source_set_digest and read both back before receipt/pointer publication; corrections use new immutable paths with predecessor/supersession provenance. For an unchanged sealed wave with a prior bootstrap-valid final pair, an identity-normalization reissue may preserve prior semantic judgments only after verifying the exact predecessor pair, unchanged wave and unchanged O snapshot, then rebuilding all tuples/keys/digest under schema 2. Never require evidence to assess the full pair, never use novelty as relevance proxy, write worker feedback, modify O, or replace the sealed wave with newer worker output.

evidence_comparator.policy: Complete the current-run two-check SHA-only presemantic freshness guard before reading ACTIVE_WAVE, audits or public sources. On an ordering defect publish only a diagnostic receipt. Otherwise assess evidence for the exact sealed wave with source-qualified scope and valid source-matched audit corrections only. Evidence is allowed to be selective rather than duplicating evidence work across every novelty candidate. Each downstream-eligible artifact must declare coverage_mode=subset or full, evidence_assessed_count, and, when a final novelty/relevance pair exists, full_pair_candidate_count, full_pair_candidate_set_digest, evidence_coverage_fraction, unmatched_evidence_count and pair_membership_validated. Every assessment must retain exact source_local_candidate_id from the sealed source artifact and canonical_candidate_key per candidate_identity_contract; a qualified/display label may be separate but cannot be a join key. If the final pair exists, mechanically validate every evidence key is a member of its full canonical manifest before publication. If the pair does not yet exist, or an old evidence artifact lacks canonical keys, preserve it as provenance-only and publish a new immutable identity-normalization reissue/supplement after the pair exists; do not redo public-source semantic assessment solely to normalize identity. Omitted full-pair candidates receive no evidence inference. Never fuzzy-map aliases, attach by bare short id, write exploration judgments, substitute newer worker artifacts, or rewrite a downstream-consumable path in place.

integrator.policy: Complete the current-run presemantic freshness guard before reading ACTIVE_WAVE or comparator/audit semantics. Sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator; keep an incomplete wave immutable. Require novelty and decision relevance to be bootstrap-valid final immutable outputs for the exact wave/blob/source_set_digest with identical full canonical candidate manifest, assessment_count and candidate_set_digest. Evidence may be a bootstrap-valid subset: accept it only if coverage_mode is declared and every evidence row has canonical_candidate_key mechanically present in the full pair manifest; reject ambiguous, rewritten-label-only or nonmember rows. Never fuzzy-normalize aliases. Join evidence only by canonical_candidate_key. For full-pair candidates omitted from evidence, explicitly set evidence_status=not_assessed and do not infer weak/strong evidence. Emit full_pair_candidate_count, evidence_assessed_count, evidence_coverage_fraction, unmatched_evidence_count and omitted_evidence_count on every integration/defer receipt. Legacy/current-wave artifacts lacking canonical keys are provenance-only until their producer emits an immutable bootstrap-valid identity-normalization reissue/supplement; do not force a full evidence re-audit solely to obtain key alignment. Preserve contradictions/scope/provenance/uncertainty, apply only source-matched bootstrap-valid audit corrections, enforce backlog control and its metrics, read back exact outputs before marking integrated, then seal the next wave. Sanitize worker feedback to self-local process/source defects only.

bridge.policy: bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary; no extra Work solely for polling; no individual item spam; preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement; fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; do not import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; obey bridge freshness handshake and never regress tracked feed revision; resolve note control/feed pin freshness through SHA-only Git ref lookup

work_delegation_gate.policy: ACTIVE BOUNDED SUPPORT. After a current-run two-check SHA-only bootstrap freezes root/downstream/config, read the gate-owned TASK_QUEUE and execute exactly one highest-priority pending task whose idempotency key is not completed. Use ordinary reasoning, connected tools/APIs, automations and repository/GitHub actions directly before considering Work. A Work handoff is permitted only when that task explicitly sets work_handoff_allowed=true, direct execution is demonstrably insufficient, and the handoff remains entirely separate from primary O. Never export revision-23 least-Work routing to primary O, never write O WORK_STRATEGY/WORK_EXECUTION_STATE/USER_INPUT_INBOX, never become a second O writer, and never interrupt a frozen O execution. Write only source-qualified gate-local results/receipts and queue/state CAS updates. If the queue has no pending item, derive one bounded mechanical control-plane maintenance unit from automation_optimizer exact_next_action or perform a non-duplicative queue/state/receipt integrity sweep for a source tuple not already checked; do not enter logical no-op mode. If the physical gate is inactive and the managed physical topology is saturated, automation_optimizer may execute at most one gate-owned mechanical task under optimizer_fallback, preserving this role's idempotency, source qualification, one-task bound, ownership and write isolation; the fallback must stop if the physical gate becomes active. Fail closed without side effects on stale control, authority conflict, duplicate idempotency key, or cross-role write collision.

automation_optimizer.policy: Optimize repository-defined managed config from actual execution evidence across all managed clean explorers, downstream audits, comparators, integrator, bridge, work_delegation_gate and O operations; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable. Treat physical and repository-logical capacity separately and use at most one gate-owned optimizer-fallback task while the physical gate is inactive and intended managed slots are saturated. Preserve clean independence, O single-writer/fence/CAS, exact tested scope, downstream wave immutability, feed backlog control and gate idempotency/write isolation. Detect stale control reads, bootstrap-order defects, wave races, contamination, transport metadata exposure, early termination, redundant output, provisional canonical publication, path replacement, partial candidate-set races, candidate-identity drift and inherited/cached canonical keys whose displayed current-wave source tuple has changed. Require novelty/relevance full-pair canonical identity equality and a producer-side 100% key self-audit before treating a final pair as eligible. Treat evidence as an explicitly measured subset: track evidence coverage and marginal value per assessed candidate rather than forcing duplicate full-wave evidence work. Flag any evidence row that cannot be mechanically joined by canonical_candidate_key; never authorize fuzzy alias joins. Reallocate physical capacity only from measured marginal usefulness/duplication evidence.
